title: Need for Speed: Shift Xbox 360
render_path: Retail guest draw stream through the project's emulator-free native Vulkan presenter; no Xenos GPU-render path or synthetic fragment override

before.observation: The original menu rows and selection highlight render, but the title, language names, and select prompt are missing.

after.observation: The original menu title and all six labels (English, Français, Italiano, Deutsch, Español, Nederlands) plus SELECT [A] are visible.

fix.root_cause: Vertex shader exports to Xenos interpolator registers were collapsed into Vulkan location 0, while the pixel shader read UVs from a nonzero register.
fix.change: Preserve all 16 Xenos interpolator indices as matching Vulkan locations, initialize and consume the matching per-stage registers, and forward those locations through the rectangle-list geometry stage.
fix.regression: xbox_shader_translate_check asserts separate exports and the pixel r[1] connection.

retail_frame150_after_geometry_interface.note: This later frame-150 run was black and is not used as visual proof of the language menu.

evidence_scope.capture_order: The after image was captured after the interpolator-index fix and before the follow-up geometry-stage pass-through change. In the captured frame, label draws #710-#731 use topology 0; the geometry pass-through change affects the separate topology-2 draws #708-#709. The final code passes both validation-enabled test suites, but a visible language-menu frame has not been recaptured with that final geometry change.
evidence_scope.android: The ARM64 consumer build is blocked in the existing shared ReXGlue SDK fiber_posix.cpp because Android NDK 28.2 does not declare getcontext, makecontext, or swapcontext. No Process 1 runtime files were changed; the language menu has not been tested on the phone after this fix.
